payload.summary: Codex review found a P2: awaiting slow/unbounded history recovery kept the failed send in ChatSending and blocked retries. Addressed in PR #838 head bbc9ef5ebdb04dc5243775a9053625293172ec31 by immediately emitting the fallback/original error and releasing only the failed send's gate before reconciliation. Added delayed-read/retry regression (15 new cases, 18 total state-engine tests). Reviewer thread answered/resolved; new exact-head CI/re-review requested.
decisions: No timeout introduced: inference error is terminal immediately; later history reads are guarded by revision and cannot overwrite a newer retry.
Old-head Web PASS is not final-head evidence.
Physical S24 FE, RAM stability and #837 closure remain reviewer/platform-owned.
payload.next_action: Inspect final-head CI and re-review; address any concrete failures; submit immutable claim-bound review packet to Main/Reviewer with G5 still pending.
